name: @synth-personas/cli
description: Command-line interface for the synth-personas evaluation engine. Ships the bundled persona library and Codex/Claude Code skill files.

scripts._comment_prepare: Mirrors assets/personas, skills/, and .agents/skills/ from the repo root into this package dir so that `npm pack` ships them. The mirrored copies under packages/cli/{assets,skills,.agents}/ are gitignored — NEVER edit them, ALWAYS edit the canonical copies at the repo root. See scripts/prepack.mjs for details.
